text.hi: अपनी किताब में पेज 80 पर कविता पढ़ो, फिर जवाब दो।
text.hinglish: Apni kitaab mein page 80 par kavita padho, phir jawab do.
text.en: Read the poem on page 80 of your book, then answer.

steps.question: Who always comes on market days?

questionMeaning.hi: बाज़ार के दिन हमेशा कौन आता है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Baazaar ke din hamesha kaun aata hai?

steps.modelAnswer: The balloon man always comes on market days.

modelMeaning.hi: बाज़ार के दिन हमेशा गुब्बारे वाला आता है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Baazaar ke din hamesha gubbaare waala aata hai.

steps.question: What does he hold?
steps.modelAnswer: He holds a lovely bunch of balloons.

modelMeaning.hi: वह गुब्बारों का एक सुंदर गुच्छा पकड़े रहता है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Woh gubbaaron ka ek sundar guchchha pakde rehta hai.

steps.question: What colours are the balloons that shine far away?

questionMeaning.hi: दूर से चमकने वाले गुब्बारे किस रंग के हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Door se chamakne waale gubbaare kis rang ke hain?

steps.modelAnswer: The balloons are red and purple, blue and green.

modelMeaning.hi: गुब्बारे लाल, बैंगनी, नीले और हरे हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Gubbaare laal, baingani, neele aur hare hain.

steps.question: What would the balloons look like in the sky?
steps.modelAnswer: The balloons would look pretty sailing high in the sky.

modelMeaning.hi: आसमान में ऊँचे तैरते गुब्बारे बहुत सुंदर दिखेंगे।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Aasmaan mein oonche tairte gubbaare bahut sundar dikhenge.

steps.question: What does the poet say in the third stanza?

questionMeaning.hi: तीसरे पद में कवि क्या कहता है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Teesre pad mein kavi kya kehta hai?

options: Some balloons are big, some small, tied with a string; in the wind they tug hard.
The balloons burst in the sun.
steps.answer: Some balloons are big, some small, tied with a string; in the wind they tug hard.
steps.modelAnswer: In the third stanza the poet says that some balloons are big and some are small. They are all tied together with a string, and when the wind blows they tug and tug like anything.

modelMeaning.hi: तीसरे पद में कवि कहता है कि कुछ गुब्बारे बड़े और कुछ छोटे हैं। सब एक डोर से बँधे हैं, और हवा चलने पर ज़ोर-ज़ोर से खिंचते हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Teesre pad mein kavi kehta hai ki kuchh gubbaare bade aur kuchh chhote hain. Sab ek dor se bandhe hain, aur hawa chalne par zor-zor se khinchte hain.

steps.question: Why do we see the balloons even when carts and people get between?

questionMeaning.hi: गाड़ियाँ और लोग बीच में हों, फिर भी गुब्बारे क्यों दिखते हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Gaadiyaan aur log beech mein hon, phir bhi gubbaare kyon dikhte hain?

options: They are high up and shine in the sun.
steps.answer: They are high up and shine in the sun.
